justifications.slope: A provisional mobility geometry descriptor; weight is a researcher-set prior.
justifications.local_relief: A provisional local elevation-range descriptor at the declared support.
justifications.terrain_roughness: A provisional elevation-dispersion descriptor, not traction.
justifications.landform_morphology: A low-weight relative-position class summary only.

earth_source_product: USGS 1 Meter bare-earth DEM; tile 12 x36y481; project ID_SouthernID_2018_D19
uncertainty_method: 30 deterministic spatial block-bootstrap replicates with 3x3-cell blocks; the same sampled blocks are used jointly across features and the weighted score, preserving local spatial and cross-feature dependence within blocks. This is a descriptive resampling variability estimate, not a calibrated confidence interval. Block size is a configuration assumption; sensitivity to block size and DEM measurement/instrument uncertainty are not estimated.
